meanings.note: Adjective formed with the common Slavic suffix '-н-' from a noun/verb root. Agrees in gender, number, and case with the noun it modifies ('cold').

examples.text: Месть подают к столу только холодной.
examples.trans: Revenge is served to the table only cold.

examples.text: Холодная водка.
examples.trans: Cold vodka.

examples.text: Вот хорошая ты баба. Холодная.
examples.trans: You are a good woman. Cold.

meanings.note: High-frequency Russian clause-linking conjunction meaning 'and', inherited from Common Slavic roots and used constantly in natural spoken dialogue.

examples.text: Погоди, друг, не спеши с выводами.
examples.trans: Wait, my friend, do not rush to conclusions.

examples.text: О чём ты вообще сейчас говоришь?
examples.trans: What are you even talking about right now?

examples.text: Ты так сильно расстроился из-за этого?
examples.trans: Did you get so upset because of this?

meanings.note: Manner/predicative adverb in '-о', derived from the neuter short form of the corresponding adjective.

examples.text: И желательно подавать её с кровью.
examples.trans: And preferably it should be served rare.

examples.text: Костя сказал это совершенно желательно и спокойно.
examples.trans: Kostya said this quite preferably and calmly.

meanings.note: Prefix 'за-' marks beginning an action, covering, or stopping by along the way (stem 'канчивать'). Used as an imperfective (ongoing/repeated action) verb meaning 'to finish, to conclude', paired with 'закончить'.

examples.text: Ладно, давай быстро заканчиваем наш разговор.
examples.trans: Alright, let us quickly finish our conversation.

examples.text: Мы заканчиваем нашу работу.
examples.trans: We are finishing our work.

examples.text: Марина, давай заканчивать эту опасную акцию.
examples.trans: Marina, let's end this dangerous protest.

meanings.note: High-frequency Russian personal or demonstrative pronoun meaning 'our', inherited from Common Slavic roots and used constantly in natural spoken dialogue.

examples.text: Ладно, давай быстро заканчиваем наш разговор.
examples.trans: Alright, let us quickly finish our conversation.

examples.text: А, так вот же наш Константин.
examples.trans: Ah, well here is our Konstantin.

examples.text: Давайте уже быстро открывать наши карты.
examples.trans: Let us quickly show our cards already.

meanings.note: Prefix 'раз-' ('apart, un-, thoroughly') indicates distribution or intensive action (stem 'говор'). Common masculine noun meaning 'matter' in everyday Russian.
